text:
The friend holds a fee simple subject to an executory limitation, and the sister’s children who reach 25 hold a shifting executory interest that is contingent because the church-use condition has not occurred. Because the sister is a life in being and all her children are ascertained at her death, the interest satisfies the Rule Against Perpetuities, so title remains in the friend unless and until the lot is used for church purposes. The deceased son took nothing, and the daughter may take only if she reaches 25 and the condition occurs.
CONFIDENCE: 82
